title: Norway’s King Harald dies aged 89
summary_full: Norwegians gather to remember monarch whose death comes amid scandal over links between crown princess and Jeffrey EpsteinNorwegians have gathered in their thousands to pay their respects to King Harald V, Europe’s oldest reigning monarch, who has died, aged 89, in Oslo. He was succeeded immediately by his son, King Haakon VIII.The new king thanked “the government and Norwegian people for their support and sympathy for the royal family at this time”. A period of national mourning was announced as crowds left wreaths and messages outside the royal palace in Oslo. Continue reading...
